meta.name: organic-growth-advisor
meta.description: Identify which organic growth path to pursue — new segments, geographies, channels, or products. Use when diagnosing where a growth constraint lives and which McKinsey growth level to act on next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断增长瓶颈并选择最优有机增长路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析业务增长受阻的原因并选择下一步扩张方向
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose growth bottlenecks and select the best organic growth path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze why growth is stuck and choose the next expansion move

howto.what: Claude 会问两个问题（客户/市场熟悉度、产品变化程度），然后推荐一个有机增长路径（新客户细分、新地理区域、新分销渠道或新产品/服务），并给出理由、诊断问题和第一步实验。
howto.when: 当你说增长停滞、不确定选哪个增长方向，或需要快速判断约束在哪时触发。

say.text: 我们产品增长停滞了，帮我诊断该选哪个增长路径。
say.note: Claude 会问两个问题，然后给出推荐。

say.text: 我应该拓展新客户细分还是新地区？怎么判断？
say.note: Claude 会引导完成诊断并解释理由。

howto.what_en: Claude asks two questions (familiarity of customer/market & degree of product change), then recommends one organic growth path (new segments, geographies, channels, or products), with rationale, diagnostic question, and a first experiment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say growth is stalling, you're unsure which growth path to pick, or need a fast constraint diagnosis.

say_en.text: Our product growth is stalling. Help me diagnose which growth path to pursue.
say_en.note: Claude will ask two questions then give a recommendation.

say_en.text: Should I go after new customer segments or new geographies? How to decide?
say_en.note: Claude will walk through the diagnosis and explain reasoning.
